# Connor Love

> AI-readable summary for connorlove.com.

Connor Love is a web developer, creative developer, and frontend developer based in Columbus, Ohio. He builds custom websites, web applications, interactive product experiences, and AI-focused interfaces for Columbus clients, businesses across Ohio, remote teams, founders, agencies, and product companies worldwide.

## Projects

- HonestUI: A source-first React component library with accessible UI components, semantic themes, Apache ECharts charts, icons, visual effects, and editable MIT-licensed source code.
- Clove Colors: A free color workbench for creating palettes, semantic color systems, light and dark themes, contrast reports, visual previews, and production-ready design tokens.
- Tokenizer: An interactive browser tool that compares Connor's byte-lossless Unigram tokenizer with nine established tokenizer baselines and a reproducible benchmark suite.
- LoveSans: A custom sans-serif typeface system designed for digital products, branding, and interface design.

## Articles

### When Code Becomes Cheap, Judgment Becomes Valuable

- URL: https://connorlove.com/articles/web-developer-age-of-ai
- Published: 2026-07-14
- Topics: Web Development, Artificial Intelligence, Career, Product Thinking
- Summary: AI can produce code faster than ever. The web developers who thrive next will be the ones who know what to build, how to judge it, verify its quality, and take responsibility for the final product.
- Direct answer: As AI makes code generation cheaper, a web developer's value increasingly comes from understanding the problem, directing the work, applying technical judgment, verifying quality, and owning what ships.
